description: This file defines the LocalStore class responsible for lightweight persistent storage of app state such as shopping cart contents and recent searches within an Android application. It utilizes SharedPreferences and offers methods to read and write cart data and recent search terms.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that manages local key-value data persistence for shopping cart and recent searches using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: readCart
methods.description: Reads a persisted shopping cart map from SharedPreferences, parsing a specially formatted string, and returns a Map of product IDs to quantities.

methods.name: writeCart
methods.description: Persists a given cart map into SharedPreferences as a formatted string.

methods.name: readRecentSearches
methods.description: Reads a list of recent search strings from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: writeRecentSearches
methods.description: Persists a list of recent search strings into SharedPreferences.
